_readme: Registry of hosted legal documents. Each entry under 'versions' is immutable:
once a version has shipped, NEVER edit its content file — publish a new
version by adding a new content file (e.g. msa/v1-1.html), appending a
versions entry, and moving 'current'. scripts/legal/build.py verifies the
sha256 of every listed content file and refuses to build on any mismatch.
Regenerate pages with: npm run legal:build

documentation.description: The Documentation for the Sidney platform under the Satorus Master Services Agreement: platform description, user instructions and the Credit Schedule.
